objective: Estimate Full, Fixed Sector, and Adaptive outcomes over seven fixed maps after replacing the fixed 0.1 s A* deadline with a common bounded 0.25 s budget.

stages.stage1: repetitions 1-5; all 35 triplets must pass infrastructure/source gates before stage2

mode_order: Deterministic rotating order within every triplet.
blocking_gate: Stop on any infrastructure/source error, or any Full/Adaptive non-completion, contact, or speed violation. Retain Sector safety/non-completion as an outcome if the run is otherwise valid.
required_adaptive_contract: Exactly four distinct goal-change Full-refresh requests and four certified returns to Sector per completed five-goal mission.
predeclared_metrics: Adaptive Full-open transitions and refresh acknowledgements

prior_evidence.c31_stopped_reason: Urban Full repeat 1 stopped safely at waypoint 3 after repeated 0.1 s A* timeouts; no contact or speed violation.
prior_evidence.c32_urban_full_gate: 3/3 safe completions, 0 contacts, mean 53.57 s, no flight retries.

claim_limit: Finite simulation evidence on the declared maps; not a population-level or real-world guarantee.
